request: Let me mark important tasks and focus on those first

questions.ask: When a task is marked important, should it automatically move to the top of the list, or would you also like a way to show only the important tasks (like a filter toggle)?
questions.why: determines whether we just change sort order or also add a filter view/control

questions.ask: If an important task is also marked done, should it still stay near the top, or should finished tasks always drop to the bottom regardless of importance?
questions.why: determines the sort logic (importance-first vs done-status-first) and whether importance and done interact

questions.ask: How should someone mark a task as important — a star/flag icon they click (like a favorite), or a checkbox similar to the existing 'done' checkbox?
questions.why: determines the UI control added to each task row and its visual treatment

findings.note: tasks table only has id, title, done columns — no 'important' field exists yet; adding one requires a schema change
REST API: GET/POST /api/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/:id (currently only toggles 'done'); would need to accept an 'important' field too, and GET would need to return tasks pre-sorted or support a filter
renders a plain <li> per task with a checkbox (done) and title span, always in DB order (ORDER BY id); no sorting/filtering logic exists client or server side
simple single-list UI, dark theme, no filter controls or task metadata beyond checkbox+title; any 'important' marker or filter toggle would be new UI

reply: A separate view, not re-sorting the main list. Just on and off, no levels. And it should stay important even after it's done.

spec.title: Add important flag and filter view for tasks
spec.summary: Let users mark tasks important via a checkbox and switch to a separate view showing only important tasks, without reordering the main list.
acceptance: Each task row has an 'important' checkbox alongside the existing 'done' checkbox
Toggling the important checkbox persists after a page reload
A view toggle (e.g. 'Show important only') switches the list to show only tasks marked important
A task marked done while important remains visible in the important filter view and keeps its important flag
Switching back to the default view shows all tasks again
unchanged: Default view task order remains sorted by id, with no automatic re-sorting based on importance
The existing done checkbox and its toggle behavior work exactly as before
Newly created tasks default to not important
spec.check: Automated check marks a task important, reloads, and confirms the flag persisted; marks it done and confirms it still appears in the important-only filter view; confirms the default view's task order is unchanged (still by id) after marking tasks important
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the important-only view is a pure client-side/read filter that never mutates or re-sorts the underlying task order, and that the important flag is stored independently of and unaffected by the done flag.
